features: Instant Wireless Screen Casting – No WiFi Needed Enjoy seamless screen mirroring without relying on WiFi or apps. Simply plug in the transmitter and receiver to start casting instantly with stable, low-latency performance.
Stunning 4K@50Hz Visual Experience Experience ultra-clear visuals with support for up to 4K@50Hz output. Perfect for presentations, streaming, gaming, and everyday viewing on larger screens.
True Plug & Play Convenience Just connect and start casting within seconds—ideal for professionals, students, and home users.
Stable 10M Wireless Range Delivers smooth and uninterrupted transmission up to 10 meters. Designed for reliable performance across meeting rooms, living spaces, and classrooms.
One-Tap Smart Control Easily control casting with a dedicated button—start or stop screen sharing instantly via the transmitter and adjust display orientation (portrait/landscape) via the receiver.
100W PD Pass-Through Charging Keep your device powered while casting with support for up to 100W Power Delivery. Perfect for long work sessions, meetings, or binge watching.

Premium Aluminum Build with Efficient Cooling Crafted with a lightweight aluminum body and ventilation design for effective heat dissipation. Slight warmth during extended use is normal, ensuring stable and reliable performance.
Wide Compatibility (Type-C Devices) Works with Type-C devices supporting DisplayPort Alt Mode or Thunderbolt, including MacBook, Windows laptops, tablets, and compatible smartphones.
description: Upgrade your screen sharing experience with the Portronics SkyCast Wireless Type-C to HDMI Screen Casting Adapter, designed for seamless plug-and-play connectivity without the need for WiFi, apps, or complex setup. Simply connect the transmitter and receiver to instantly mirror video and audio from your laptop, tablet, or compatible smartphone to a TV, projector, or monitor. Supporting up to 4K@50Hz resolution, it delivers sharp, vibrant visuals ideal for presentations, streaming, and entertainment. The adapter ensures stable, low-latency wireless transmission with a reliable range of up to 10 meters, giving you flexibility across rooms. It also features simultaneous PD charging support via an additional Type-C port on the transmitter, allowing your device to stay powered during extended use. Built with a premium aluminum body and ventilation design, it offers efficient heat dissipation for consistent performance; slight warmth during prolonged usage is normal and does not affect functionality. Compact, durable, and highly compatible with USB-C devices supporting DisplayPort Alt Mode, SkyCast is a reliable solution for modern wireless display needs.
